posts.title: Khitoli Water Dam Cleanliness Drive: 15–20 October 2026
posts.summary: Six days of cleaning the Khitoli Water Dam and its surroundings. Everyone is welcome to join.
posts.body:
From 15 to 20 October 2026, Kalam Foundation volunteers are cleaning the Khitoli Water Dam and the area around it.

Clean water sources matter for everyone in the village — for drinking, farming and animals. Plastic and waste near the dam harm all of these.

How to join: just turn up with gloves and a bag, or message us on WhatsApp at +91 95221 51016. Anyone aged 14 or above can volunteer.
